title: The Data Compression Book (2nd Edition)
annotation: Rujukan klasik komprehensif algoritma kompresi data meliputi Huffman coding, LZW, run-length encoding (RLE), arithmetic coding, dan kompresi fraktal.

title: Video Codec Design: Developing Image and Video Compression Systems
annotation: Buku panduan desain codec video yang mengupas secara teknis estimasi gerak antar-frame (motion compensation), transformasi DCT, kuantisasi, dan struktur stream H.264/MPEG-4.

title: Fundamentals of Multimedia (3rd Edition)
authors: Ze-Nian Li, Mark S. Drew, Jiangchuan Liu
annotation: Bab 7 sampai 12 menguraikan standar format citra (JPEG, JPEG 2000), audio (MPEG Audio, MP3, AAC), dan video (MPEG-1/2/4, H.264, H.265, AV1).
